inputs.name: hand over from Data Labeling Pipeline to Data Versioning

output.level_0: The labeled till scan lines vanish before the versioning step can capture them for the next retrain.
output.level_1: No handover exists between labeling and versioning, so the team cannot trace which scan data trained the model.
output.level_2: A data engineer manually copies labeled scan lines into the versioning store before the weekly retrain begins.
output.level_3: The pipeline automatically pushes labeled scan lines to the versioning store as soon as labeling completes.
output.level_4: The automated handover logs every labeled scan line batch with audit trails for compliance and model reproducibility.
